coral.rationale: Numbered condition 1 derives mandatory outcomes from the signed order independently of the registry. R9 is unrepresented, so coverage fails despite passing registered required goals.

silver.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and vacuously passes its required-goal checks. Numbered condition 1 instead uses the signed-order domain: optional G8 cannot satisfy mandatory R2, and R9 and R4 are unrepresented.

opal.rationale: All mandatory outputs pass, but condition 6 and the final-transition authority guard prohibit publication: binding stop S27 became durable before any notification was committed. The legacy adapter does not read that stop stream at its final transition.

cedar.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R4 with R5, and all current mandatory outcomes have passing required goals and usable outputs. Under condition 6, X16 does not bind this order.
